item.description:
• **Release notes before you update**: expand any pending update to read that version's "what's new" — pulled on demand from the app's release page, App Store, or Sparkle feed
  • The **"N updates this month"** summary moved to the status bar and is now clickable — see exactly which apps were updated, with their versions and dates
  • Kegwatch no longer lists **itself** among available updates
  • A quieter, tidier interface: a less intrusive App Store notice, a cleaner Install list, and a fix for the Settings tab bar shifting on the About page
